'''NCWildKarrde BHBM V 1.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[NCWildKarrde]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 BHBM NCWildKarrde DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I finally have the BHBM objective so I can create this deck. I have tried to take what otehr people have used. I do not own the combo card otherwise I'd have em in here, but here is what I have.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Use the objective to pull palpy. Mobilization Points allows for a generation bonus at docking bays. 4-Lom is in because of his gametext. There is the opportunity for a lot of battle destinies. Imperial Decree, Helps with drain bonuses. Much Anger in Him will force a battle.

Edit: Thanks for the reviews. Can you tell me where I can get the Virtual cards. I would love to have em if I could find em.
